Cards, as a turn's or a worker's explanation, are retired; the cards stored before stay readable.","tier":"core"},{"caption":"Everything you see and press","holds":[],"id":"window","name":"Window","paths":["ui/"],"purpose":"The page: the list, the rail, Home, History and the Map view. It reads the event log, feeds the core, and carries out what needs the window: notices, sounds, the Dock badge, the terminals, and each command handler, which only forwards to the server.","tier":"core"},{"caption":"Owns the terminals","holds":[],"id":"terminal-daemon","name":"Terminal daemon","paths":["terminal-daemon/"],"purpose":"A background process that keeps every terminal alive, so they outlive the app.","tier":"interface"}],"version":2}
